description: Part 4V lesson 04-21 (fixed-form RPG IV skeleton, Issue #35). Uploads the four reference samples V0421A-D (src/qrpglesrc/v0421s/bs/cs/ds.rpgle), two exercise answers V0421S/V0421T (solutions/04-21) and four deliberately wrong sources V0421W-Z (RPG III columns, missing F spec, opcode in column 27, result field without length) into QRPGLESRC (RCDLEN 112, created by the file step if absent), sets member type RPGLE, compiles every member with CRTBNDRPG OPTION(*EVENTF) and copies the compile event file (QTEMP/EVFEVENT member = source member) into VFYEV21 so RNF message ids and severities can be read. Negative examples are compiled first (they are expected to fail; DLTPGM before and CHKOBJ after show whether a program object came out). Then CALLs the six good programs (all non-interactive: QSYSPRT only, TOKUIM/JUCHUM read-only) and captures QSYSPRT through CPYSPLF into VFYSP21 (CPYSPLF may fail with CPF3303 in this harness job; the raw run section then carries the text, see part06-01-cvtrpgsrc). Expected output: V0421A prints HELLO, RPG III! ending at column 20; V0421B prints 1,738.00 ending at column 20 (same as R0401A/R0402A); V0421C prints one line SUM=   13 DIF=    7 MUL=   30 QUO=    3 REM=    1 CNT=   42 OVF=99990; V0421D prints the two ACME TRADING CO lines J00001/J00003 (same as R0408A); V0421S should print 38.00; V0421T should print the lines of customer C00003. CURSET makes the batch library the current library and LIBFIX removes and re-adds it at *FIRST of the user library list, so TOKUIM/JUCHUM resolve to it first without naming any private library (there is no placeholder for the first library, so RMVLIBLE of it is not done). Wrapper program name is TPART04V21 (first 10 chars of T+batch), so sibling batches part04v-22.. do not collide.

steps.label: CURSET
steps.cmd: CHGCURLIB CURLIB(&LIB)

steps.label: LIBFIX
steps.cmd:
RMVLIBLE LIB(&LIB)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
ADDLIBLE LIB(&LIB) POSITION(*FIRST)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

steps.label: SRCTYPE
steps.cmd:
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0421A) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0421B) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0421C) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0421D) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0421S) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0421T) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0421W) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0421X) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0421Y) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0421Z) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

steps.label: SPLPF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYSP21) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYSP21) RCDLEN(133) TEXT('04-21 spooled-file text capture'))

steps.label: SPLCLR
steps.cmd: CLRPFM FILE(&LIB/VFYSP21)

steps.label: EVFPF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYEV21) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYEV21) RCDLEN(300) TEXT('04-21 compile event capture'))

steps.label: EVFCLR
steps.cmd: CLRPFM FILE(&LIB/VFYEV21)

steps.label: CPV0421W

steps.label: EVV0421W
